proof:
set_option maxHeartbeats 0 in
  classical
  change ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Final.BP), M6.Final.Admissible N a b → M6.Final.CountingCorrect N a b
  intro N _ a b h
  have hs : M6.ActualTransfer.span a b < N := by
    unfold M6.Final.Admissible at h
    tauto
  have ha : a.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.degree_le_natDegree
    exact_mod_cast (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_max_left a.natDegree b.natDegree) hs)
  have hb : b.degree < (N : WithBot ℕ) := by
    apply lt_of_le_of_lt Polynomial.degree_le_natDegree
    exact_mod_cast (lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.le_max_right a.natDegree b.natDegree) hs)
  have hboundary (P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N)) :=
    (M6.ActualTransfer.boundary_trace_inputs N a b hs P).trans
      (M6.ActualCounts.boundary_pinned_sum N a b ha hb P)
  have hcharacter (P : M6.Pinned.Pins (2*N)) :=
    (M6.ActualTransfer.character_trace_inputs N a b hs P).trans
      (M6.ActualCounts.cycle_pinned_sum N a b ha hb P)
  have hcard := M6.ActualCounts.logical_card N a b ha hb
  unfold M6.Final.CountingCorrect
  repeat' constructor
  all_goals intros
  all_goals first
    | assumption
    | exact?
    | (simp_all only [M6.Final.LX, M6.Final.BX, M6.Final.CX]; exact?)
queries: M6.ActualResult normalized boundary cycle Q Q_total theorem signatures
